statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
The denial was based on the service not being deemed medically necessary according to current coverage guidelines and clinical criteria
A 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms
